prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone—the right choice depends on whether you need a single implant, bone grafting, or a full-arch restoration. For a **single implant or a case involving gum or bone issues**, I’d start by consulting a **board-certified periodontist**. **AZPerio** has Phoenix-area locations and says its board-certified periodontists provide implant placement and related procedures. [AZPerio](https://azperio.com/dental-implants/)

Other options to compare include **Implants & Periodontics**, which lists board-certified periodontists, and **ClearChoice Phoenix**, which offers care with an oral surgeon and prosthodontist and reports a 4.8/5 rating from 533 reviews. Those are useful starting points, not independent proof that either is the best. [Implants & Periodontics](https://www.implantsandperioaz.com/) · [ClearChoice Phoenix](https://www.clearchoice.com/locations/az/phoenix/20830-north-tatum-blvd/)

Before choosing, get **two consultations** and ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what credentials and experience they have with your specific case, what the full written cost includes, and what follow-up or warranty is offered. Check the dentist’s license and any claimed board certification independently, and ask for a copy of the treatment plan and imaging.
